title: Remember Me
description: Saves every spawn point a player has ever set and falls back to the last valid one on death.
body:
Vanilla Minecraft only remembers a single spawn point. If that bed or respawn anchor is destroyed when you die, you respawn at the world spawn.

This mod maintains an ordered history of up to 20 spawn points per player. On death, it scans from newest to oldest and respawns you at the last one that still exists, so losing your most recent bed does not erase all prior ones.
- Tracks beds and respawn anchors (not /spawnpoint commands).
- History persists across server restarts (stored in world saved data).
- Works on dedicated servers and in single-player.
- No client-side installation required.
